groups.title: words 讠
groups.note: Speech on the left. In his traditional cards it is 訁; here it is two strokes, 讠.

chars.story: Fresh, clear words to someone you respect: please.
chars.note: Also 'invite' and 'treat': 我请你 'my treat'.

chars.story: The words I and my people speak: our language.
chars.note: 吾 is his Analects 'I'.

chars.story: Words that give the nod: you are allowed.
chars.note: Its commonest words are 也许 'perhaps' and 许多 'many'.

chars.story: Upright words set down in writing: proof.
chars.note: Also 'certificate': 身份证 'identity card'.

chars.parts: 讠 words + 周 all round (sound)
chars.story: Words passed all round the table until everything fits: adjust.
chars.note: Also 'transfer' and 'look into': 调查 'investigate', 强调 'stress'.

groups.title: hand 扌
groups.note: A hand on the left: the hand is doing it.

chars.story: A hand held out toward one spot: point at it.
chars.note: Also 'finger', and 'refer to': 是指 'means'.

chars.story: A hand shoving a bird off its perch: push.
A hand hauling a standing man toward you: pull.
chars.note: Often spells foreign names: 拉丁 Latin.

chars.story: A hand trimming a branch into a tool: technical skill.

groups.title: water 氵 and ice 冫
groups.note: Three drops on the left for water; two drops for ice and cold.

chars.parts: 氵 water + 㫃 flag + 子 child
chars.story: A child following the flag over water and land: touring.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'swim'. Modern 游 is mostly 'tour' and 游戏 'game'; 游泳 is 'swim'.

chars.story: Water streaming like a newborn's wet hair: flow.
Ferrying everyone evenly across the water: aid.
chars.note: Nearly always in 经济 'economy'. Traditional 濟: 齊 on the right became 齐.

chars.parts: 冫 ice + 兄 elder brother (sound)
chars.story: Big brother checks the ice before anyone steps out: the situation.
chars.note: Two drops, not three: traditional 況 had 氵 water.

chars.story: A bird landing dead on its mark on the ice: accurate.
chars.note: Also 'allow': 不准 'not allowed'. It also stands for traditional 準.

groups.title: tree 木
groups.note: A tree on the left or at the foot: wood, timber, things that grow.

chars.story: Timber laid so each piece has its own square: a grid.
chars.note: In words it is 'pattern, standard': 性格 'character'.

chars.story: What holds a tree to the ground: its root.
chars.note: Also a counter for long thin things: 一根烟 'a cigarette'.

chars.story: A foot planted on a felled tree, stripping off a long piece.
chars.note: A counter for long thin things: 一条路 'a road'. Traditional 條: 亻 and 攵 dropped away.

chars.story: Birds flocking onto one tree: gather.
chars.note: Also an episode of a series: 第一集.

groups.title: silk 纟
groups.note: Silk thread on the left. In his traditional cards it is 糸; here it is 纟.

chars.story: Knots along a silk cord, each reached in turn: levels.
A silk cord looped loosely round a ladle, not measured: approximately.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'restraint' (約). Also 'arrange to meet': 约会 'a date'. 糸 became 纟.

chars.story: Silk drawn out thin: a thread, a line.
chars.note: Traditional 線: 泉 on the right became 戋.

chars.story: Tie on more silk and keep selling: continue.
chars.note: Traditional 續: 賣 became 卖.

groups.title: person 亻 and 儿
groups.note: 人 squeezed onto the left as 亻, or walking on two legs 儿 at the foot.

chars.story: The person standing between buyer and seller names the price.
chars.note: Traditional 價: 賈 became 介.

chars.parts: 亻 person + 丨 post + 矢 arrow at a target
chars.story: A person standing like a post by the archery target, waiting for his turn.
chars.note: Above all in 时候 'time, when': 小时候 'as a child'.

chars.story: A person posing beside an elephant picture: one resembles the other.
chars.note: Also 'image, portrait'. 象 alone is in stage 5.

chars.story: Two little legs toddling along: children.
chars.note: Often a tail that adds nothing: 哪儿 'where', 这儿 'here'. Traditional 兒 had a head on top.

chars.story: A foot stepping out in front of the legs: go first.
A man on two legs bearing a heavy helmet: he can overcome.
chars.note: Also 'gram', and common in foreign names: 马克思 Marx.

groups.title: right hand 又
groups.note: 又 is a right hand; on the left or at the foot it still grips something.

chars.story: Two right hands clasped together: friends.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'companion'.

chars.story: A hand gripping an ear, the old trophy of war: take.
A hand holding up a branch: support.
chars.note: Also a counter for pens, songs and troops: 一支笔.

chars.story: A hand grabbing at a bird: difficult.
chars.note: Traditional 難: 堇 on the left became 又.

chars.parts: 月 boat + 卩 kneeling man + 又 hand
chars.story: A hand pushing a kneeling man to his work on the boat: serve.
chars.note: Also 'clothes' and 'obey'. The 月 here was once a boat, 舟.

groups.title: mouth 口
groups.note: A mouth, or any opening.

chars.story: A mouth speaking, its words sharp as an axe: you listen.
chars.note: Traditional 聽 had 耳 ear and 心 heart; the new shape keeps a mouth.

chars.story: An ox led to the altar, and a mouth telling the spirits.
chars.note: Also 'sue': 被告 'the defendant'.

chars.story: A mouth tacked onto the end of a sentence, nudging: shall we?
chars.note: At a sentence's end: 走吧 'let's go', 是吧 'right?'. Also 'bar' in 酒吧.

chars.story: An order from the mouth above you: your fate.
chars.note: Also 'life' (生命) and 'order' (命令 'command').

groups.title: counting
groups.note: Numbers, and how many.

chars.story: Two strokes, one above the other: two.
chars.note: Before a counter, 'two' is 两: 两个人 'two people'.

chars.parts: - a box with two strokes inside
chars.story: A box divided by two strokes into four corners: four.
A small low table: how many things will fit on it?
chars.note: His Analects card: 'slight' (幾). 幾 is now written 几. Also 'a few': 几天 'a few days'.

chars.parts: - a forked weapon on a handle
chars.story: One forked stick, held by one man: single.
chars.note: Also 'list, form': 菜单 'menu'. Traditional 單 had two 口 on top.

chars.story: A mother putting up her hair, the same every morning.

groups.title: parties and posts
groups.note: The groups people belong to, and the posts they hold.

chars.story: People standing together on their legs under one roof: a party.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'one's kind' (黨). Modern 党 is a political party. 黑 at the foot became 儿.

chars.story: A ring drawn round talented people: a gathering.
chars.note: Traditional 團: 專 inside became 才.

chars.story: People lined up on a mound: a team.
chars.note: Traditional 隊: 㒸 on the right became 人.

chars.story: A roof over heaped-up files: an official's hall.
The head that gives the orders: it takes the lead.
chars.note: Also 'neck, collar': 领带 'necktie'. Traditional 領: 頁 became 页.

chars.story: Ten over one: one man who knows ten things, a scholar.
chars.note: In modern words a person with a role: 护士 'nurse', 士兵 'soldier'. Lookalike 土 earth has the long stroke at the foot.

chars.story: A woman bowing like ripe grain, handing it over: entrust.
chars.note: Mostly in 委员会 'committee' and 党委 'Party committee'.

groups.title: walk 辶
groups.note: The walking road along the bottom: going somewhere.

chars.story: A big man striding down the road until he gets there: attain.
chars.note: Traditional 達: 羍 became 大.

chars.story: Walk to the workshop and tell them what to make.
Only an axe's throw down the road: near.

groups.title: cloth 巾
groups.note: 巾 is a cloth hanging down.

chars.story: A hand shaking out a cloth for all to see: make it known.
chars.note: Also plain 'cloth'.

chars.parts: 卅 ornaments + 冖 belt + 巾 cloth
chars.story: Ornaments on a belt, a cloth hanging below, carried everywhere: bring.
chars.note: Also 'belt, zone': 皮带 'belt', 热带 'the tropics'.

chars.parts: 丨 two strokes + 帀 banner
chars.story: A banner on a pole where the master stands: teacher.
chars.note: His Analects card in 師: 𠂤 on the left became two strokes. Also 'expert' in job names.

groups.title: show 示
groups.note: 示 is an altar; on the left it shrinks to 礻.

chars.story: An altar with the offerings laid out on top: put on show.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'altar', the component. As a word, 示 means 'show'.

chars.story: An altar on the mound marking where one land meets the next: the border.
chars.note: Above all in 国际 'international' and 实际 'reality'. Traditional 際: 祭 became 示.

chars.story: A wooden post set up to show the way: a mark.
chars.note: Traditional 標: 票 became 示.

groups.title: knife 刂 and strength 力
groups.note: 刂 is a knife standing on the right; 力 is a ploughing arm. Tell them apart.

chars.story: Scoring lines with spear and knife: marking out a plan.
chars.note: Also 'mark off, draw a line', and 'row a boat'.

chars.story: A knife carving the terms into bronze treasure: a fixed principle.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'then'. In formal prose it still means 'then, but'. 貝 became 贝.

chars.parts: 力 strength + 丷 two dots
chars.story: Strength with sweat flying off both sides: handling the job.
chars.note: Traditional 辦 had 辛 on both sides.

chars.story: Strength in the field: a man.

groups.title: must and sure
groups.note: Saying that something is needed, or certain.

chars.parts: - a heart 心 with a slash through it
chars.story: A heart with a stake driven through it: it must be so.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'surely'.

chars.story: Rain dripping off the beard of a man waiting for what he needs.
Stone and horn: nothing is firmer.
chars.note: In words 'sure, correct'. Traditional 確: 隺 became 角.

groups.title: names abroad
groups.note: Each also stands for a place abroad: 英国 Britain, 德国 Germany, 亚洲 Asia.

chars.story: The flower at the very centre of the grass: the finest, a hero.
chars.note: Short for Britain and English: 英国, 英语.

chars.story: A squat shape that always stands just behind the leader: second place.
chars.note: Mostly in 亚洲 'Asia' and in foreign names. Traditional 亞.

chars.parts: 彳 step + 十 ten + 罒 eye + 一 one + 心 heart
chars.story: Steps taken with a straight eye and a single heart: virtue.
chars.note: Also short for Germany and German: 德国, 德语.

groups.title: 尔 thou
groups.note: 尔 on its own, and inside 称.

chars.story: A hook pointing down at a small figure: thou.
chars.note: Literary 'you, so'. In modern prose mostly 偶尔 and foreign names. Traditional 爾.

chars.story: Grain weighed on the scales and given its name: call it by name.
chars.note: Also 'weigh' and 'praise'. Traditional 稱.

groups.title: history and books
groups.note: The record of the past, and the books it is kept in.

chars.story: Struggling along a cliff with all your strength: going through it.
chars.note: Above all in 历史 'history'. Traditional 歷 and 曆 'calendar' both became 历.

chars.parts: - a hand holding up a record
chars.story: A hand holding up the written record: history.
A few quick brush strokes left of 書: a book, writing.
chars.note: Traditional 書 had a hand with a brush over 日. 书记 is 'Party secretary'.

groups.title: big 大
groups.note: 大 is a man with arms spread wide.

chars.story: Big, and then a dot more: too much.
chars.note: 太好了 'great!'. Lookalike 犬 dog has the dot on the shoulder.

chars.parts: 丶 two dots + 大 big
chars.story: A big man with two tufts of hair on top: the head.
chars.note: Often a tail meaning 'thing': 石头 'stone', 里头 'inside'. Traditional 頭 had 页 head.

chars.story: Rice and big things sorted into heaps: categories.
chars.note: Traditional 類 had 犬 and 頁 too.

groups.title: places
groups.note: Towns, mountains and the capital.

chars.story: Three peaks side by side: a mountain.
Earth walls built complete round a town: a city.
chars.note: The old sense 'city wall' lives on in 长城.

chars.parts: - a tall tower on a mound
chars.story: A tall tower on a mound: the capital.
chars.note: Short for Beijing.

chars.parts: - a roof open on one side
chars.story: A roof with one side open to the world: wide.
chars.note: In place names: 广东, 广州. Traditional 廣: 黃 under the roof dropped out.

groups.title: seek 求
groups.note: 求 alone, and inside 球.

chars.story: A fine fur coat that everyone is after: seek.
A round jade bead everyone reaches for: a ball.
chars.note: 王 on the left is jade, 玉, not king.

groups.title: life and feeling
groups.note: Dying, feeling, hoping, rejoicing.

chars.parts: 歹 bones + 匕 kneeling man
chars.story: A man kneeling beside bare bones: die.
chars.note: Also 'extremely': 忙死了 'terribly busy'.

chars.parts: ⺍ three dots + 冖 cover + 见 see
chars.story: Eyes under a cover suddenly seeing: you become aware.
chars.note: 觉得 'feel, think' is the commonest. Traditional 覺: the top became ⺍冖, 見 became 见.

chars.parts: 亡 gone + 月 moon + 王 man on the ground
chars.story: A man on the ground gazing at the moon for someone who has gone.
chars.note: In most words 'hope, expect': 希望 'hope', 失望 'disappointed'.

chars.story: Drums on a wooden stand beating out: everyone is happy.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'joy' (樂). The drums and strings are now a few strokes. Also 'music': 音乐.

groups.title: doing things
groups.note: Everyday verbs whose shapes are best learned whole.

chars.parts: 丩 twisted cord + 攵 tap
chars.story: Tapping tight the cords round everything that comes in: collect.
chars.note: Also 'receive' (收到) and 'put away'.

chars.story: Hands under a crossbar pushing it up high: lift.
chars.note: Traditional 舉 had 手 hand at the foot.

chars.parts: 勹 wrapping + 巳 unborn child
chars.story: A child wrapped up in the womb: wrap.
chars.note: Also 'bag': 书包 'schoolbag'.

chars.parts: ⺈ hand + 彐 hand + 亅 stick
chars.story: Two hands tugging at one stick: strive for it.
chars.note: Traditional 爭.

chars.story: A forked pole hung with washing in the wind: dry.
chars.note: Also 'do, work' (干活, 干什么) and 'cadre' (干部): it stands for both 乾 'dry' and 幹 'do'.

groups.title: whole shapes
groups.note: Pictures and simplified shapes with no parts worth splitting.

chars.story: A horse cut down to three strokes: head, back and legs.
chars.note: Also a surname. Traditional 馬 had four legs as dots.

chars.story: The right half of a split log: a slice.
chars.note: Also a counter for flat things: 一片叶子 'a leaf'.

chars.story: Two wings beating away from each other: it is not so.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'wrong', as in 是非 'right and wrong'.

chars.story: Steam rising in three layers: air, gas.
chars.note: Also 'anger' and 'manner'. Traditional 氣 had 米 rice under the steam.

chars.story: A dot standing firm over a cross: rightness.
chars.note: His Analects card in 義: 羊 and 我 became a dot over 乂. Commonest in 意义 'meaning' and 主义 '-ism'.

chars.parts: - a spindle in a few strokes
chars.story: A spindle that winds only one thread: specialized.
chars.note: Traditional 專: a spindle over 寸 hand.

chars.story: One figure bent over another, face flushing: colour.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'face / colour'.

groups.title: hair 彡
groups.note: Three slanting strokes: hair, brush strokes, patterns.

chars.story: A frame filled in with brush strokes: shape.

chars.parts: 厶 star + 大 person + 彡 rays
chars.story: A person stepping under a shower of starlight to join in: take part.
chars.note: Traditional 參 had three 厶 stars on top.

sentences.en: I feel that the German language can be very difficult.
It is necessary for you to go there immediately.
When will I get to Tokyo?
America's Civil War lasted four years.

sentences.zh: 他是个城市规划的专家。
sentences.en: He is an expert in the area of city planning.

sentences.zh: 每个机场都有英文指示。
sentences.en: Information is given in English at every airport.

sentences.zh: 亚历克斯是非二元性别。
这则报告在最近发布了。
sentences.en: The report has been recently published.

sentences.zh: 日本是世界高科技产业的领头人。
sentences.en: Japan is a leader in the world's high-tech industry.

sentences.zh: 在我们公司每月都会举办社团活动。
sentences.en: Every month at our company, they run a community activity.

sentences.zh: 我看上去像是很有力气的人，可实际上并非如此。
sentences.en: I may look strong, but I'm honestly not.
